reason: The debug-only developer probe submitted distinct world-3D and plane-1/UI draws across a 16:9 top target on the physical Thor. It falls back to a centered 4:3 composite when no dominant current top structured 3D slot exists or capture 3D is present. Live Peach-intro and controllable Castle Garden scenes exercised the world-safe dual-UV route. A same-checkpoint native-versus-probe comparison showed the Castle Garden gaining left/right world content outside the native 4:3 rectangle. The Thor-specific primary rotation now covers the world quad while draw mode 8 samples the packed UI with the native top-down Y mapping. The physical pause overlay and movement smoke are now readable and stable at scene level. This still does not prove object aspect, new-side-region culling, exact HUD/glyph/bottom geometry or transition stability.
